technical-summary: The v3 writer now recomputes and verifies the complete native plan key using resolved values/facts, snapshot digest/root, ordered rank device identities and measured identities; it requires owner provenance and cache key integrity. The real v3 fixture publishes and reloads through the owner plan cache and feeds the retrieved plan/rank-demand to P1 and final writer. It verifies owner receipt, manifest identities, and refusal on changed digest/root/device identity. `bc_serving_v3_writer_test`, exact-recipe ABI44 `bc_native_v3_engine_test` (including writer subprocess), and ordinary v2 `bc_serving_test` pass (1/1 each); one generated manifest archive verified; diff check clean. No GPU; production gate remains closed.
user-summary-candidate: Connected the v3 writer fixture to the real owner plan cache and made it verify the full native configuration and ordered GPU identity in measured plan keys. Focused v2 and v3 tests pass; production native admission remains closed.
